interventions.detail: librosa not in requirements; pinned librosa==0.9.2 because newer librosa breaks piano_transcription_inference.load_audio (librosa.core.audio removed)
installed audioread (and mido) explicitly; piano_transcription_inference imports audioread but it is no longer pulled in transitively
apt install ffmpeg (mp3 decoding) and libsndfile1
wget needed by piano_transcription_inference auto checkpoint download; checkpoint pre-downloaded with curl instead
importing dataset.py downloads nltk punkt/tagger data at runtime; pre-triggered in setup.sh
used uv venv on Python 3.12 with PyTorch CPU wheel from download.pytorch.org
